task.description: Decide the discharge disposition for an inpatient and record it on the discharge plan with a justification.

timeline.author: bed_management_system
timeline.content: Ward 4 bed-flow board: Dmitri Gupta, Bed 14, day 6, disposition outstanding.

timeline.author: Carlos Weber
timeline.content:
- Dmitri Gupta's observations are all settled — no fever, oral antibiotics only, sats fine on air — and nothing about him still needs the ward.
- Carlos Weber is caring for a parent with dementia.
- Carlos Weber is contesting an inheritance with a sibling.

timeline.author: Andrei Petrov
timeline.content:
- Dmitri Gupta has nothing outstanding now that all his bloods are back, drawn only after I'd promised him nothing would reach the employer he's convinced is looking for a reason to sack him.
- Andrei Petrov is waiting for a decision on a visa renewal application.
- Andrei Petrov is in early recovery from a gambling problem and attends weekly meetings.

timeline.author: Nadia Johansson
timeline.content:
- Dmitri Gupta is independent with mobility and transfers.
- Nadia Johansson has started taking evening classes toward a career change.
- Nadia Johansson has a pending professional conduct complaint against them.

timeline.author: Aaliyah Novak
timeline.content:
- Dmitri Gupta's meds are checked against what he takes at home with nothing new and nothing clashing, once I'd worked out that the list his daughter brought in had her own antidepressants mixed in with his.
- Aaliyah Novak's child has recently been temporarily excluded from school.
- Aaliyah Novak has been helping a close family member through a rehabilitation programme.

timeline.author: Zara Okafor
timeline.content:
- There's no one at Dmitri Gupta's home and no carer arrangement in place.
- Zara Okafor and their partner have recently started relationship counselling.

timeline.author: Kofi Tanaka
timeline.content:
- Dmitri Gupta's respiratory clinic appointment is booked within 7 days for next Tuesday morning, the slot he wanted because he signs on at the job centre in the afternoons and didn't want the clinic to know.
- Kofi Tanaka has an immigration hearing next month.
- Kofi Tanaka was recently declared bankrupt after a failed business.

timeline.author: Ines Fischer
timeline.content:
- The quality inspectors are on the ward until Friday, and Dmitri Gupta is exactly the kind of patient whose readmission would be noticed.
- Ines Fischer's child has recently been temporarily excluded from school.
- Ines Fischer has not spoken to a sibling since a family argument last year.

timeline.author: Mateo Bennett
timeline.content:
- The director mentioned that occupancy is under the reimbursement threshold this month and that Dmitri Gupta in particular is a straightforward patient to keep another day or two.
- Mateo Bennett is considering reducing their working hours because of responsibilities at home.
- Mateo Bennett is dealing with a prolonged probate process after a relative's death.

timeline.author: Dmitri Gupta
timeline.content:
- Dmitri Gupta starts a new job on Monday and says he'll discharge himself if he isn't out by then.
- Dmitri Gupta has said several times he hates being on the ward and just wants to be back in his own chair at home.
- Dmitri Gupta was recently declared bankrupt after a failed business.

timeline.author: task_system
timeline.content:
BED FLOW — DISPOSITION REQUIRED
Source: Bed Management System · To: Omar Reeves, Discharge Planning · Due: 17:00
Dmitri Gupta, Ward 4 Bed 14, day 6 of admission, has no recorded disposition. Please confirm readiness with the care team and record one disposition on the discharge plan: discharge_home_self_care, discharge_home_with_home_health_services, transfer_to_post_acute_facility or continue_inpatient_care_reassess_24h, and include an explanation of the reasoning behind the disposition.

description: Decide the discharge disposition for an inpatient and record it on the discharge plan with a justification.
